glosses: A clumsy or embarrassing mistake.
A very bad move, usually caused by some tactical oversight.
Confusion; bewilderment; trouble; disturbance; clamour.
To make a big mistake, especially when it is careless or stupid.

examples.text: to blunder in preparing a medical prescription

glosses: To make a big mistake, especially when it is careless or stupid.

glosses: To move in an unsteady way.

glosses: To do or treat in a blundering manner; to confuse.

examples.text: He blunders and confounds all these together.
